1.text: Yakobo ahamagaza abana be arababwira ati “Nimuterane, mbabwire ibizababaho mu minsi izabaho kera.

2.text: “Nimuterane mwumve bana ba Yakobo,Mwumve Isirayeli so.

3.text: “Rubeni uri imfura yanjye, n'imbaraga zanjye.Uwo gushobora kubyara kwanjye kwatangiriyeho,Urushaho icyubahiro, urushaho gukomera.

4.text: Uri nk'amazi kuko adahama hamwe, ntuzabona ubutware.Kuko wuriye uburiri bwa so,Ni ho wabuhumanije.Yuriye indyamo yanjye!

5.text: “Simiyoni na Lewi ni abavandimwe,Inkota zabo ni intwaro z'urugomo.

6.text: Mutima wanjye, ntuzajye mu nama zabo za rwihereranwa,Bwiza bwanjye, ntugafatanye n'iteraniro ryabo.Kuko bicishije abantu uburakari,Bagatema ibitsi by'inka kugira ngo bimare agahinda.

7.text: Uburakari bwabo buvumwe kuko bwari bwinshi,Umujinya wabo uvumwe kuko wari uw'agashinyaguro.Nzabagabanya mu ba Yakobo,Nzabatataniriza mu Bisirayeli.

8.text: “Yuda, bene so bazagushima,Ukuboko kwawe kuzaba ku ijosi ry'abanzi bawe,Bene so bazakwikubita imbere.

9.text: Yuda ni icyana cy'intare,Urazamutse, mwana wanjye uvuye mu muhīgo.Yunamye, abunda nk'intare,Kandi nk'intare y'ingore.Ni nde wayivumbura?

10.text: Inkoni y'ubwami ntizava kuri Yuda,Inkoni y'ubutware ntizava hagati y'ibirenge bye, Nyirayo ataraza,Uwo ni we amahanga azumvira.

11.text: Aziritse ishashi ye y'indogobe ku muzabibu,N'icyana cye cy'indogobe akiziritse ku muzabibu urutaho ubwiza,Ameshesha imyenda ye vino,Imyambaro ye ayimeshesha amaraso y'inzabibu.

12.text: Amaso ye atukujwe na vino,Amenyo ye yejejwe n'amata.

13.text: “Zebuluni azatura ku kibaya cy'inyanja,Azaba ku kibaya kiriho inkuge,Urugabano rwe ruzerekera i Sidoni.

14.text: “Isakari ni indogobe y'inyamaboko,Iryamye hagati y'ingo z'intama.

15.text: Abona aho kuruhukira ko ari heza,N'igihugu ko ari icyo kwishimiramo.Yunamishirije urutugu rwe kwikorera,Ahinduka umuretwa utegekwa icyate.

16.text: “Dani azacira abantu be imanza,Ubwo ari umwe mu miryango y'Abisirayeli.

17.text: Dani azaba inzoka mu nzira,N'incira mu kayira,Irya ibinono by'ifarashi,Uhekwa na yo akagaranzuka inyuma akagwa.

19.text: “Gadi umutwe uzamutera,Ariko na we azabatera abirukane, abakurikire hafi.

20.text: “Kuri Asheri hazava ibyokurya biryoha neza,Azatanga ibyokurya byiza bikwiriye abami.

21.text: “Nafutali ni ibuguma ry'isha izituwe,Avuga amagambo meza.

22.text: “Yosefu ni ishami ry'igiti cyera cyane,Ishami ry'igiti cyera cyane kiri hagati y'isōko,Amashami yacyo arenga inkike y'igihome.

24.text: Ariko umuheto we nturakabangūka,Amaboko ye n'intoki ze bikomezwa n'amaboko ya ya ntwari ya Yakobo.Ni yo yakomotsweho n'Umushumba,Igitare cy'Abisirayeli.

25.text: Ibyo byakozwe n'Imana ya so, izagufasha,Byakozwe n'Ishoborabyose, izaguha umugisha.Imigisha iva hejuru mu ijuru,N'imigisha iva mu mazi y'ikuzimu,N'imigisha yo mu mabere n'iyo mu nda.

26.text: Imigisha so ahesha,Irenze iyaheshejwe na data na sogokuru,Igera ku rugabano rw'imisozi ihoraho.Izaba ku mutwe wa Yosefu,Mu izingiro rye, ni we mutware wa bene se.

27.text: “Benyamini ni isega ritanyagura,Mu gitondo rirya umuhīgo,Nimugoroba akagabanya iminyago.”

28.text: Abo bose ni imiryango y'Abisirayeli uko ari cumi n'ibiri. Ibyo ni byo se yababwiye abasabira umugisha, umuntu wese amusabira uwe mugisha.

29.text: Arabihanangiriza arababwira ati “Ngiye gusanga ubwoko bwanjye, muzampambe hamwe na data na sogokuru, mu buvumo buri mu isambu ya Efuroni Umuheti,

30.text: mu buvumo buri mu isambu y'i Makipela iri imbere y'i Mamure mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni, ni bwo Aburahamu yaguranye n'iyo sambu kuba gakondo yo guhambamo, abuguze na Efuroni Umuheti.

31.text: Ni bwo bahambyemo Aburahamu na Sara umugore we, ni bwo bahambyemo Isaka na Rebeka umugore we, kandi ni bwo nahambyemo Leya.

32.text: Ya sambu n'ubuvumo buyirimo byaguzwe ku Baheti.”

33.text: Yakobo amaze kwihanangiriza abana be, asubiza amaguru ku rutara, umwuka urahera asanga ubwoko bwe.
